meta.name: outcome-roadmap
meta.description: Transform an output-focused roadmap into an outcome-focused one that communicates strategic intent. Rewrites initiatives as outcome statements reflecting user and business impacts. Use when shifting to outcome roadmaps, making a roadmap more strategic, or rewriting feature lists as outcomes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将功能列表转化为战略成果描述
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把功能清单变成传达业务价值的战略路线图
copy.tagline_en: Turn feature lists into strategic outcome statements
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform a feature roadmap into one that communicates business impact

howto.what: 这个技能会把你的产品路线图从“要做什么功能”改写成“要达成什么成果”。它会分析每个功能背后的客户问题和商业目标，然后生成以成果为导向的陈述，例如“帮助客户更快找到产品，从而提升订单价值”。
howto.when: 当你提供一份现有的功能路线图，或者提到需要将路线图变得更战略化、以成果为导向时，这个技能就会触发。

say.text: 帮我把这份功能路线图改写成成果路线图。
say.note: 技能会读取你提供的路线图并逐项转换。

say.text: 把“Q2上线高级搜索”改成成果陈述。
say.note: 技能会分析该功能背后的客户和商业价值。

say.text: 我的路线图太功能化了，帮我改成成果导向。
say.note: 技能会要求你提供路线图，然后进行转换。

howto.what_en: This skill transforms your product roadmap from a list of features into outcome statements. It analyzes each feature's customer problem and business goal, then rewrites it as an outcome like 'Enable customers to find products faster, increasing order value.'
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide an existing feature-focused roadmap, or when you mention the need to make a roadmap more strategic and outcome-oriented.

say_en.text: Rewrite this feature roadmap into an outcome roadmap.
say_en.note: The skill will read your roadmap and transform each item.

say_en.text: Convert 'Q2 launch advanced search' into an outcome statement.
say_en.note: The skill will analyze the customer and business value behind the feature.

say_en.text: My roadmap is too feature-heavy, help me make it outcome-driven.
say_en.note: The skill will ask for your roadmap and then perform the transformation.
